title: iammojogo's Block Identifier
description: Simple mod to show what block you are viewing. Not complex like many mods. To the point!
body:
iammojogo's Block Identifier Mod

This is a simple addition to the gui that is less complicated than most mods (for now)! It simply shows you what the debug would show in some versions of what block you are raycasting to. 

This can be helpful for some texture packs that have textures appearing similar in either color or texture patterns.

🔧 COMPATIBILITY

Works with JEI, JourneyMap, Xaero's Minimap, Optifine, and most client-side mods.

Requirements:

Minecraft 1.21.11
Forge 61+
Client-side only (no server installation needed)
